reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #1 ('Concept design: smart contract marketplace') does not request a concrete code change to this repository. It is a DESIGN/DOCUMENTATION deliverable: the body asks to 'Design a set of desktop web UI mockups and UX flow descriptions' and to 'Submit your concept design as a PR to this repository, following the folder structure of the template ... including functionality descriptions and UI mockups.' There is no reproducible defect and no engineering feature to implement in code; the requested artifacts are PNG mockups plus prose UX-flow descriptions under concepts/. The repository itself is a concept-only repo (description 'Wyvern Protocol Frontend Concept Development'; README: 'Collection of concept designs for frontends'), containing only README.md and concepts/example (README.md + 7 PNGs) and no application source. Additionally the deliverable is already covered by an open competing PR: PR #7 'Concept design: Smart Contract Marketplace frontend & UX flows (closes #1)' by s6pa1rta3n-lab (opened 2026-08-30) adds concepts/smart-contract-marketplace/README.md plus 8 mockup PNGs and edits README.md; PR #6 (Jbry123, 2018) is also an open competing submission. Funding is effectively dead: the Gitcoin bounty (gitcoin.co/issue/ProjectWyvern/frontends/1/323) was escalated to Gitcoin's moderation team for inactivity, repeated 'Is this bounty still open?' questions were left unanswered by the funder, and the repository's last push was 2018-05-19. Per policy this is a documentation/design deliverable with an already-competing PR -> blocked; the checkout was left unchanged and no fork/PR was created.
